## Most of the consultancy industry's professionals hold university degrees (percentage in Spain)

[Figure]

[Figure]

Source: AEC (Spanish Association of Consulting Firms)

Due to the type of services offered, consulting firms attract the most qualified profiles in the job market. 65.8% of the total number of professionals in 2024 were university graduates.Another year again, the percentage of women with a higher education was above that of men (70.8% verSUS 63.8%).

On the other hand,the presence ofvocationaltraining graduates dropped with respect to the year before, representing 20.1% of the total in 2.24. In this case, the percentage of women, 13.9% of the total, was less than the men, which represented 22.9%.
